hypothesis: Replace the flat quadratic balance term with a smooth hinge (softplus of |ratio-0.5|-band) so the raw partition stays inside ±1.5% without fighting the cut term, cutting repair flips (103/238/353) and preserving whatever cut structure was learned, which should reduce TNS across all circuits.
analysis: Hypothesis failed: all scores negative, TNS worsened (mean −15.8%). Cut and wcut rose on all circuits (C1 137→169, C2 318→381), and crit_cross jumped sharply on C1/C2 (0.011→0.098, 0.000→0.165), plausibly driving the WNS/TNS losses despite modest repair-flip reductions (C1 103→90, C2 238→181). C3 barely improved flips (353→351) with cut up. Seed spread is high (std 0.331; C3 per-seed +0.14 to −0.92), so results are unstable. Next: tighten the hinge band or add a cut-aware penalty and re-test, prioritizing crit_cross reduction.
